ja: 天 来 変 幻 !!
「伝説の大将軍編」主人公であり、後に新世大将軍へと出世を遂げる烈光頑駄無が、待望のLEGENDBBで登場。
豪華２種類の鎧と各種武装が大ボリュームで付属。
●　豪華鎧２種が付属
武闘家として修行を積んだ衛府弓銃壱が装着する「闘覇の鎧」、
轟天頑駄無より与えられた三烈神の鎧の一つ「烈光の鎧」の豪華２種の鎧が付属。
闘覇の鎧
兜の前立やアンクルガードなど、各部に金メッキを採用。拳法を繰り出す右手の手甲などの特徴的なディテールを再現。
バックパックには厳光の弓・トンファーを装着可能。
烈光の鎧
右半身に氷の力、左半身に炎の力を宿した鎧を、クリアパーツとメッキをふんだんに用いて再現。
ディスプレイ台座
未使用時の鎧をディスプレイできる専用の台座が付属。
●　BB戦士No110 轟天頑駄無（別売り）と超連動！
BB戦士 No.110 轟天頑駄無の肩へ台座の取付が可能！
●　新規関節機構により広い可動範囲と豊富なオプション！
愛刀の豪嵐丸、厳光の弓が付属。
利き腕の左手で剣を使い、右手からは拳法を繰り出す自己流の武術“剣勢拳”を再現可能！
●　今石進氏による新規書き起こしイラストを贅沢に使用した、豪華フルカラーパッケージ!
取扱説明書には新作コミックワールドを掲載！

en: Heavenly transformation!
Rekko Gundamu, the main character of the "Legendary Great Shogun Edition" who later rose through the ranks to become a new generation of great generals, is now available in the long-awaited LEGENDBB.
Two types of luxurious armor and various weapons are included in large quantities.
● Comes with 2 types of luxurious armor
The "Armor of Battle" worn by Efu Yujuichi, who has trained as a martial artist.
Comes with two luxurious types of armor, "Armor of Light", one of the three god's armors given by Goten Gundam.
Armor of Conqueror
Gold plating is applied to various parts such as the helmet placket and ankle guard. Reproduces characteristic details such as the back of the right hand that performs martial arts.
It is possible to attach a bow and tonfa of harsh light to the backpack.
Armor of Radiant Light
The armor, which has the power of ice on the right side and the power of fire on the left side, is reproduced using plenty of clear parts and plating.
display pedestal
A special pedestal is included to display the armor when not in use.
● Super linked with BB Senshi No110 Goten Gundam (sold separately)!
A pedestal can be attached to the shoulder of BB Senshi No.110 Goten Gundam!
● Wide range of motion and abundant options thanks to the new joint mechanism!
Her beloved sword Goarashimaru and Genko no Bow are included.
You can recreate your own style of martial arts, ``Kenseiken,'' where you use a sword with your dominant left hand and perform martial arts with your right hand!
● Luxurious full-color package that uses newly transcribed illustrations by Susumu Imaishi!
The new comic world is posted in the handling manual!
